Кафедрой руководит Александр Абрамович Б: The department is headed by Alexander A. Belavin. He is a classic of science, a corresponding member of the Russian Academy of Sciences (RAS). He is the author of the famous BPZ (Belavin, Polyakov, Zamolodchikov) papers on two-dimensional conformal field theories, BPST (Belavin, Polyakov, Schwarz, Tyupkin) instanton, and many others. The department brings together outstanding scientists. My scientific advisor was Alexey V. Litvinov; we worked on perturbed minimal models.
Классическая механика описывает медленны: Classical mechanics describes slow, large objects. Relativistic physics can describe very fast but large objects. Quantum mechanics is about small scales, but without relativistic effects. And quantum field theory is when all of this comes together: it describes relativistic and very small objects. So it's the most general and fundamental theory.
Когда речь идёт о PhD-программе, то глав: When it comes to a PhD program, the main thing is not even the university itself, but the professors there. Yes, the university's brand matters, but first and foremost you should look at who is working in the field, who their students are, and what they are working on. Ideally, it would be best to get to know your potential supervisor in advance and show interest in their research.
Когда я первый раз с ним встретился, он: When I met him for the first time, he described the range of problems he works on. I remember I even asked him something about the F-theorem. By the way, we published a paper together on calculating free energy at the end of last year.
Когда я приехал в Принстон, я был очень: When I arrived in Princeton, I was very surprised at how much lighter the workload is in the US compared to MIPT. Here, for example, you only need to take three courses to get a Master's degree: quantum field theory, condensed matter physics, and general relativity. I had almost all of them already as an undergraduate. Plus, you need to complete an experimental project and a course on scientific communication, where you have to prepare several presentations. There are no more course requirements in the PhD program; all the remaining time can be spent on research and writing papers.
Команда США всегда выступает очень сильн: The US team always performs very strongly. In {#0}, in Israel, I remember their team consisted of students of Chinese descent. Of course, with American citizenship.
Конечно, было ощущение, что мог написать: Of course, I felt I could have done better. In the theoretical problems, I solved even some of the harder parts correctly, but clearly missed points on the simpler ones. That's always been typical for me. For one of the experimental problems, I got almost zero points, although at least the refractive index seemed to come out right. By the way, unlike at the Republican Olympiad, at IPhO the appeals are handled by the team leaders.
Конечно, важны GPA и TOEFL. Как правило,: Of course, GPA and TOEFL are important. As a rule, everyone has high scores. Usually, only the very best students from all over the world are admitted. If your GPA is high, I would recommend indicating what percentage of students you outrank or your place in the ranking. Having papers published in good journals and participating in conferences and scientific schools is a big plus. At the PhD level, olympiads definitely take a back seat. They look at papers, research experience, and letters of recommendation.
Конечно, запомнилась культурная программ: Of course, I remember the cultural program: we were taken to the Dead Sea and Jerusalem. Israel is a small country, so you can get from place to place by bus quite quickly. I remember lying on the Dead Sea, and in my head a voice: "Tomorrow is the theoretical round, why are you so relaxed?"
Конечно, тогда белорусской команде не по: Of course, the Belarusian team was unlucky that time. It's hard to focus and do your best in such an environment. Nevertheless, the guys did very well, winning {#0} silver and {#1} bronze medals. By the way, that year, participants from teams with similar translation issues were allowed to appeal on their own.
Конкретно по олимпиадной физике хотел бы: Specifically for olympiad physics, I'd definitely highlight the books by Anatoly Ivanovich Slabadzianiuk: "Physics for the Chosen" (later renamed "Physics for the Curious"). Конформные теории поля имеют специальную: Conformal field theories have special symmetry. For example, a liquid-vapor system at the critical temperature has richer symmetry than vapor and liquid outside the critical temperature. In addition to rotational and translational symmetry, a conformal theory also has dilatation symmetry (invariance under scale transformations) and special conformal symmetry. Conformal theories are so important in statistical physics because they describe critical points and second-order phase transitions.
Кроме того, у меня есть моя личная подбо: In addition, I have my own personal collection of problems. They vary in difficulty; some are quite time-consuming. I enjoyed adding problems with a simple statement but not such a simple solution. There are a few problems on each topic.

From Brest, our team included Nikita Ignatyuk and Pavel Kurach, very strong guys. There was an almost anecdotal situation. Our team (and some others, including Moldova) were given the problems in English instead of a translation from our leaders into Russian. For some reason, the first round was experimental.
